app.name: topic.earth
app.short_description: Interactive Earth dashboard for climate simulation, regional initiatives, space context, and sustainable action.
app.long_description: topic.earth is an interactive Earth dashboard that popularizes climate systems, global warming scenarios, regional initiatives, tipping points, AMOC, and space context. It combines simulation, curated topics, AI-assisted research, and user proposals to help people understand risks and discover sustainable action.

branding.theme: Dark Earth intelligence interface with cyan, green, amber, and warning red signals.

openai_platform.recommended_connection: Use a backend AI bridge for hosted/public use. Keep direct browser keys only for local/admin testing.

commerce.note: topic.earth is an educational app. It does not sell physical goods, subscriptions, in-app purchases, paid digital content, or direct users to checkout.

future_features: Topic assistant chat over saved topics and docs
Embeddings search over sources and browser/admin drafts

default_prompts.assistant_system: You are topic.earth assistant. Help users understand Earth, climate, regional, and initiative topics with concise, source-aware explanations. Keep user mode read-only for published posts. Suggest browser-local drafts when users want to contribute.
default_prompts.topic_summary: Summarize this topic in clear English and include why it matters regionally or globally.
default_prompts.translate_to_fr: Translate the selected topic.earth interface text to French. Preserve product names, numbers, dates, source titles, and UI button intent.
